faq.a: Yes — the Dimensity 7000 and 8000 series compete head-to-head with Qualcomm Snapdragon 7-series. The 1080 and 6100+ chips are also solid for the price.

faq.q: How much storage do I need?
faq.a: 128GB minimum. 256GB is better if you shoot a lot of video. Always check for microSD support — many budget phones skip it.

faq.q: Which phone has the best camera under ₹20,000?
faq.a: Realme Narzo 70 Pro and Redmi Note 13 Pro have the best main cameras in this segment. For selfies, Samsung Galaxy A15 leads.

key_takeaways: Processor (Dimensity 7000+/Snapdragon 7+) matters more than camera megapixels.
AMOLED 120Hz display makes a bigger difference in daily use than 50% more battery.
OIS on the main camera is the difference between sharp and blurry low-light photos.
Software support (Samsung gives 4 years) matters if you keep phones 3+ years.
who_for: Anyone buying a smartphone in India on a budget. Whether you prioritize camera, battery, gaming, or overall value, this guide ranks the best picks at this price.
methodology: We compared smartphones available on Amazon India and Flipkart in this price range. For each, we evaluated the chip, display, camera sensors, battery capacity, charging speed, and software support. Picks validated against current pricing. Reviewed every 60 days.
